content.title: VCU parts ways with women’s basketball coach
content.text: Skip to contentRICHMOND, Va. (WWBT) - Virginia Commonwealth University has made a mid-season coaching change for the women’s basketball team. Beth O’Boyle, who was in the middle of her 12th season at VCU, “will not coach for the remainder of the 2025-26 season and will not return to VCU,” the school said. The team currently has an 8-15 record. O’Boyle had an overall record of 191-168. “We want to thank Coach O’Boyle for her service to VCU and her dedication to our student-athletes. We will not renew her contract and she will not coach the remainder of the season. We wish her all the best in her future endeavors. We will begin a national search immediately,” said VCU Vice President and Director of Athletics Ed McLaughlin.Assistant coach Kirk Crawford will serve as the interim coach for the rest of the 2025-26 season.Copyright 2026 WWBT.
